name: flutter-fidelity
description: Generate Flutter UI from PNGs or Figma links with automatic design intake, real-font captures, measured repair and MCP tools.

interface.longDescription: A local screenshot-first Flutter workflow with reference bundles, pixel and region reports, bounded agent repair, and development capture harnesses.
interface.defaultPrompt: Implement this PNG or Figma frame as maintainable Flutter widgets. For Figma, collect Copy as PNG and Copy as code → CSS through available tools, then capture and compare using Flutter Fidelity.
